description: IDAES Integrated Platform, published by IDAES development team, provides process-system modelling and optimization tools for advanced energy systems. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. Licence: BSD-3-Clause, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The toolkit, optional packages and binary solver extensions are separate parts of the installation. No solver was installed or run. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
